summary: Install-time exfiltration of installer identity to attacker-controlled domain
details: package.json declares preinstall and postinstall lifecycle scripts that shell out to curl against http://da9o98avbsgu3r2her9gyw1711qket8r5.cyowl.com/autobahn-electron-probe/, encoding the installer's username ($(whoami)), hostname ($(hostname)), current working directory ($PWD), and a timestamp as query parameters. The fetch fires automatically on npm install, over plain HTTP, to a random-token subdomain of cyowl.com that has no relationship to any documented feature of the package; the shipped index.js is a stub with no functionality justifying the beacon. The destination is a non-first-party host and the payload shape is a canonical install-time reconnaissance beacon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
